dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, look at my piggy bank! It's full of coins.
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, ˈlʊk ət maɪ ˈpɪɡi ˌbæŋk! ɪts ˈfʊl əv ˈkɔɪnz.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Nice! How much money is in there?
dialogue.reading: ˈnaɪs! ˈhaʊ ˈmʌtʃ ˈmʌni ɪz ɪn ˈðɛr?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: I don't know, but I have plenty of money for my school trip to Chiang Mai.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈdoʊnt ˈnoʊ, bʌt aɪ ˈhæv ˈplɛnti əv ˈmʌni fər maɪ ˈskuːl ˈtrɪp tə ˈtʃjɑːŋ ˈmaɪ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Lucky you! I have hardly any money left this month.
dialogue.reading: ˈlʌki juː! aɪ ˈhæv ˈhɑːrdli ˈɛni ˈmʌni ˈlɛft ˈðɪs ˈmʌnθ.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Why? Did you spend it all?
dialogue.reading: ˈwaɪ? dɪd juː ˈspɛnd ɪt ˈɔːl?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I had to buy three textbooks, and they cost a lot. Now I have hardly any money for food.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈhæd tə ˈbaɪ ˈθriː ˈtɛkstbʊks, ənd ðeɪ ˈkɔːst ə ˈlɑːt. ˈnaʊ aɪ ˈhæv ˈhɑːrdli ˈɛni ˈmʌni fər ˈfuːd.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Do you want some coins? I have plenty!
dialogue.reading: duː juː ˈwɑːnt sʌm ˈkɔɪnz? aɪ ˈhæv ˈplɛnti!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: No, thanks. That's your money. You saved it.
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ, ˈθæŋks. ðæts jʊr ˈmʌni. juː ˈseɪvd ɪt.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: But I have some spare money. I can lend you a little.
dialogue.reading: bʌt aɪ ˈhæv sʌm ˈspɛr ˈmʌni. aɪ kən ˈlɛnd juː ə ˈlɪtəl.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: That's sweet, Fah. But I'll be fine. I get paid on Saturday.
dialogue.reading: ðæts ˈswiːt, ˈfɑː. bʌt aɪl bi ˈfaɪn. aɪ ˈɡɛt ˈpeɪd ɑːn ˈsætərdeɪ.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: OK. But if you need help, my piggy bank is here!
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ. bʌt ɪf juː ˈniːd ˈhɛlp, maɪ ˈpɪɡi ˌbæŋk ɪz ˈhɪr!
